name: research-paper-workflow
description: A traceable, evidence-first AI workflow for research positioning, quantitative analysis, manuscript drafting, independent review, submission packaging, and revision tracking.

interface.shortDescription: Build and audit evidence-traceable research papers.
interface.longDescription: A modular workflow that keeps data, results, figures, claims, manuscript text, independent review, and submission records linked. Includes a P2 Tibetan Plateau-Arctic sea-ice adapter.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the research-paper-workflow to audit evidence before drafting, preserve uncertainty, and keep every manuscript claim traceable to local results.
